facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans walked home singing without a care in the world. People stared at him wondering why he was so joyful. Hans felt free and happy with nothing to weigh him down. When he reached home, Mother hugged him at the door. He told her about every trade he made on the road. Mother just smiled because her son was home safe.
